_meta.description: RetroDojo chipset reference dataset. Stores SoC-level CPU, GPU, process, I/O, display, audio, storage, and power support details separately from device-level implementation notes.

evidence_key.official: Official silicon vendor documentation or official device manufacturer specification page.
evidence_key.mixed: Official device page plus secondary vendor-ecosystem references; useful but not fully verified at SoC level.
evidence_key.limited: Public information is weak or incomplete; treat as provisional until official datasheet is available.

cpu.notes: Clock and core layout are confirmed by Anbernic device pages, not by a public Allwinner datasheet.

chipsets.memory_support: Public SoC-level documentation unavailable. Device implementations in catalog pair it with 1GB RAM and TF-based storage.
chipsets.display_support: Not publicly documented at SoC level.
chipsets.io_support: Not publicly documented at SoC level.
chipsets.wireless_support: No integrated wireless capability confirmed at SoC level; Wi-Fi/Bluetooth are verified only at device level.
chipsets.audio_support: Not publicly documented at SoC level.
chipsets.power_support: Not publicly documented at SoC level.
chipsets.notes: Use device-level implementation notes for charging, expansion, and multimedia until an official H700 datasheet is available.

cpu.notes: AYANEO 3 product page confirms third-generation AMD AI positioning and device implementation.

chipsets.display_support: AYANEO 3 confirms DP 1.4 over USB4 and high-refresh internal OLED/LCD options with FreeSync on LCD trim.

chipsets.audio_support: AYANEO 3 confirms dual speakers, 3.5mm jack, and tuned HyperSound 2.0 audio.
chipsets.power_support: AYANEO 3 confirms 65W PD charging and bypass charging.
chipsets.notes: This is the strongest documented chipset entry in the current catalog because AYANEO exposes unusually detailed platform information.
